summary: Approved for the two finite Algorithm 2.1 fixtures: all 216 scalar coordinates independently recomputed at 70 decimal digits agree within the frozen tolerances. KKT solves, two-sided spectral factors, squared row-norm scaling, and monotone smoothing follow the PDF.

cases.reason: Independent constrained KKT minimization starts with identity W; subsequent weights are built by applying L*Z*R plus row scaling to each matrix basis vector. The 2x2 spectral factors are evaluated from analytic eigenvalues of XX^T and X^TX, avoiding dependence on author SVD code. All three complete iterates, singular values, row norms, smoothing values and weight matrices agree.

scope_notes: Only row-sparse low-rank IRLS with rank=sparsity=1 is approved; equality of these estimates makes the printed rank/sparsity subscript inconsistency in (2.8) numerically irrelevant.
Initial W is identity, not the sum of two identity penalties; all later W combine spectral and row-sparsity terms.
The experiments remain positive-smoothing finite trajectories and do not establish RIP, recovery rates, or behavior at zero smoothing.
Expected numbers were not changed; comparison is against frozen atol=1e-10 and rtol=1e-8.
